description: This file defines the implementation of the Equals predicate (EqPredicateImpl) used in the query criteria framework within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract predicate class and implements an accept method for visitor pattern interaction.

classes.name: EqPredicateImpl
classes.description: Implementation of an equality predicate in the query framework, representing a condition where a field is equal to a specified value.

methods.name: EqPredicateImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the predicate with a value to compare against.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Implements the visitor pattern, allowing an external visitor to perform operations based on this predicate.
